operation.description: Operation to perform on the input documents.

values.name: Redact
values.description: Redact Operation will remove all entities of PHI and replace them with a placeholder value.

values.name: Surrogate
values.description: Surrogation Operation will replace all entities of PHI with a surrogate value.

values.name: Tag
values.description: Tag Operation will detect all entities of PHI, their type, and return their locations in the document.
